_comment: Photos for the four 55+ community pages, batch 2026-10-a, found 2026-10-07 on Wikimedia Commons (API). Only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA. None shows the community itself: Commons has no photo of any of the four. Each photo shows the area around it; the 'what' line says where. Files are 1200 px wide WebP, resized from the Commons 1280 px thumbnail, nothing else changed. Put the credit line under the photo or in a photo-credits line on the page, with links to the Commons page and the license URL. CC BY-SA: if a photo is cropped or edited, the edited version must carry the same license.
